# checkmk_tag_group (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve information about a CheckMK tag group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    checkmk = {
      source = "N3moAhead/checkmk"
    }
  }
}

provider "checkmk" {
  url      = "http://localhost:5000/test"
  username = "automation"
  password = "your-secret-here"
}

# Look up a tag group by ID
data "checkmk_tag_group" "example" {
  tag_group_id = "environment"
}

output "group_title" {
  value = data.checkmk_tag_group.example.title
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the tag group.

### Read-Only

- `help` (String) Help text describing the tag group.
- `tags` (Attributes List) List of tags in the tag group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `title` (String) Human-readable title for the tag group.
- `topic` (String) Topic for grouping tag groups in the UI.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `aux_tags` (List of String) List of auxiliary tags associated with this tag.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the tag.
- `title` (String) Human-readable title for the tag.
